Kento Alpha 0.5, build 952

In this build

  • ChromaKeyer keys as Nuke does: chroma gain, screen gain, the balance on red, green and blue screens, the alpha and despill biases, the black and white points and the replace modes, all checked pixel for pixel.
  • New nodes, checked against Nuke: EdgeExtend, Inpaint2, GenerateLUT (writes .cube, .3dl, .csp and .vf) and OCIONamedTransform. TimeDissolve follows its curve.
  • Comps open closer to how they look in Nuke: the classic Shuffle writes its second layer (alpha into depth and the like), MinColor uses the offset its analysis stored (Analyze on its panel), Dilate takes a separate width and height, and about a thousand more knob expressions now work, DasGrain's among them.

Not yet

  • EdgeExtend's detail amount and Inpaint2's smoothness above 2 are close, not exact.
  • Grade and ColorCorrect's mix luminance.
  • ZDefocus and SplineWarp in comps: kept, not rendered yet.
  • Paint's blur, sharpen, smear, dodge and burn; Roto open splines.

Kento Alpha 0.5, build 931

In this build

  • ChromaKeyer: the green and blue screen keyer, checked against Nuke, in comps and as a new node.
  • Fixed: the menus went from the menu bar, all but Kento, when a comp was opened over the empty window.
  • Fixed: a new Grade, ColorCorrect or GodRays failed to be made, and new nodes with an output channel started on Undistort, from another node's starting value.

Not yet

  • ChromaKeyer's chroma gain and its black and white points.
  • ZDefocus, EdgeExtend, SplineWarp and Inpaint in comps: kept, not rendered yet.
  • Paint's blur, sharpen, smear, dodge and burn; a clone source from another frame.
  • Roto open splines.

Kento Alpha 0.5, build 927

In this build

  • Color: new comps start on ACES 2.0, working in ACEScg, on the un-tone-mapped view, and Settings > Preferences > Colour sets what new comps start with. File > New comp in show starts a comp with a show's format, frame rate and color; an opened comp keeps its own and says where it differs from its show's.
  • Reads tag themselves from their files (the color interop ID, the primaries, then the file type), and the Read says what it decided and why. A file named with a color space in it no longer reads as that space under the classic config.
  • Write deliveries by use: EXR comps and plate returns, ProRes Rec.709, sRGB, H.264, HEVC, and P3 and HDR PQ. EXRs say what they hold.
  • The comp's own proxy: every Viewer and renders at This comp > Proxy's size (⌘P), with Write and Read proxy files.
  • PixelKernel: per-pixel kernels written in Kento, and the BlinkScript kernels in comps run, checked against Nuke.
  • Nagi 1.4.6, Autonomy's noise reduction, as a Kento node: motion compensation, the Light, Standard and Strong presets, the Camera menu.
  • More nodes, checked pixel for pixel: ClipTest, Toe, ColorBars, ColorWheel, CMSTestPattern, Posterize, PLogLin, CCrosstalk, HSVTool, HistEQ, MinColor, ColorTransfer, the OCIO CDL, LogConvert and Look transforms, Tile, CopyRectangle, ZMerge, ZSlice, DropShadow, DegrainBlue, Emboss, Bilateral, TemporalMedian, TimeEcho, TimeDissolve, add and remove 3:2 pulldown; LightKey and PrimeKey keys, Steadiness, LensDistortion, Kronos, VectorGenerator, MotionBlur, SmartVector and VectorDistort.
  • The manual's pictures: every chapter's figures are in, in the app and the PDF.
  • Luma Pictures' gizmos ship with Kento, in the Nodes menu.
  • Comps open with more of their expressions worked out, and a knob a script leaves out takes the value it has in a script, not a new node's.
  • Fixed: a comp's knobs left at their defaults read as a new node's in eight nodes (Rectangle's area, LensDistortion's output, Kronos's channels and others).

Not yet

  • ZDefocus, EdgeExtend, SplineWarp and Inpaint in comps: kept, not rendered yet.
  • Paint's blur, sharpen, smear, dodge and burn; a clone source from another frame.
  • Roto open splines.
